# Error Handling Checklist: Product Line B Onboarding Smoke

**Purpose**: Validate SPEC-010B failure, refusal, and recovery evidence before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-06-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Preflight And Seed Failures

- [ ] CHK001 Are Product Line B residue, `plb-platform-*` conflicts, repo sync ownership conflicts, and Product Line A ownership conflicts required to stop before mutation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Contract `seed-product-line-cli.md` §Failure Codes]
- [ ] CHK002 Are absent/ready, already-valid, refused-without-allowance, residue-blocked, and ownership-conflict target states separated clearly enough for implementation tests? [Clarity, Contract `seed-product-line-cli.md` §Existing Target Outcomes]
- [ ] CHK003 Are repeated `apply` and `verify` runs required to be idempotent and to report stable mutation status? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Contract `seed-product-line-cli.md` §Idempotency]
- [ ] CHK004 Are invalid config, malformed YAML, wrong slug, wrong repo metadata, invalid agent prefix, and missing workflow contract cases mapped to typed seed errors? [Coverage, Contract `seed-product-line-cli.md` §Failure Codes]

## Lifecycle And Enablement Failures

- [ ] CHK005 Does the spec stop if Product Line B remains enabled after smoke, cleanup fails, or smoke-owned flags remain true? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Is explicit smoke enablement required to make exactly one Product Line B synthetic smoke item eligible while sync, dispatch, and general pilot work remain paused or forbidden? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Plan §State Management Contract]
- [ ] CHK007 Are final disablement failures measurable through non-null `disabled_at`, false or absent smoke-owned flags, zero sync-owner rows, and zero remaining smoke eligibility? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012, Contract `smoke-evidence.md` §Cleanup Counters]
- [ ] CHK008 Are feature-flag-off and missing smoke-owned flag states represented as blocked or skipped evidence instead of silent success? [Coverage, Data Model §SmokeEvidencePacket, Plan §State Management Contract]

## API And Authorization Failures

- [ ] CHK009 Are invalid, unauthorized, forbidden, and out-of-scope workspace IDs mapped to stable evidence codes and expected HTTP statuses? [Completeness, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §API Evidence]
- [ ] CHK010 Are scoped API failures required for every route used as isolation evidence rather than only dashboard status? [Coverage, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §API Evidence]
- [ ] CHK011 Is Product Line A isolation violation treated as a stop condition instead of a warning or partial pass? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §SQL Evidence]
- [ ] CHK012 Are dashboard or switcher evidence failures scoped to existing surfaces so they cannot imply a new include-disabled UI mode? [Scope Control, Spec §FR-006, Contract `scoped-dashboard-evidence.md` §Switcher Evidence]

## Synthetic Smoke And Optional GitHub Failures

- [ ] CHK013 Are invalid synthetic issue schema, missing pilot labels, non-positive issue number, wrong repo metadata, or missing Product Line B marker cases represented as smoke evidence failures? [Coverage, Contract `smoke-evidence.md` §Synthetic Issue]
- [ ] CHK014 Are candidate eligibility, one root-task proof, pilot auto-route hold, and side-effect absence failures each traceable to a smoke phase status? [Measurability, Contract `smoke-evidence.md` §Phase Statuses]
- [ ] CHK015 Are missing GitHub credentials, insufficient permissions, operator refusal, or unavailable live issue writes recorded as optional skipped/not-mutated evidence that cannot fail required synthetic smoke? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications §Synthetic Smoke And Evidence]
- [ ] CHK016 Are forbidden live GitHub writes, including comments, label repair, close/delete, PR creation, sync-owner changes, and Product Line A mutation, represented as hard scope failures? [Scope Control, Spec §PR Review Packet Requirements, Quickstart §HAL UAT]

## Runtime And Environment Failures

- [ ] CHK017 Is the HAL service Node ABI mismatch documented so UAT uses `/usr/bin/node` v24.15.0 instead of an incompatible interactive Node binary? [Coverage, Quickstart §HAL UAT]
- [ ] CHK018 Are runtime-inventory failures treated as optional read-only evidence misses unless existing APIs already provide safe support evidence? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Contract `smoke-evidence.md` §Parallel Safety]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the implementation stop before editing SPEC-014C-owned adapter/runtime/dispatch files when evidence collection would require those changes? [Dependency, Spec Clarifications §Agent Substrate And SPEC-014C Parallel Safety]
- [ ] CHK020 Are retained FocusEngine/OpenClaw identities reported as inventory unless explicitly conflicting with Product Line B or Product Line A ownership? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Data Model §RetainedInventoryReport]

## Evidence And Review Failures

- [ ] CHK021 Are error messages and evidence fields redaction-safe, excluding raw SQL, stack traces, raw upstream responses, tokens, authorization headers, API keys, credentials, and matched secret substrings? [Security, Contract `seed-product-line-cli.md` §Error And Residue Object Shapes]
- [ ] CHK022 Are PR review packet and smoke evidence requirements sufficient to explain failures, skipped optional evidence, cleanup status, files avoided, and deferred follow-up work without rerunning hidden setup? [Traceability, Spec §PR Review Packet Requirements, Contract `smoke-evidence.md` §Review Packet]

## Notes

- Focus areas: preflight refusal, invalid config, lifecycle cleanup failure, API authorization outcomes, optional GitHub skips, HAL Node ABI mismatch, and redaction-safe evidence.
- Depth: Standard reviewer gate before task generation.
- Actor/timing: task author and PR reviewer before Phase 5 tasks.
